user.title: Connect Philips EyeCare Smart Lamp 2
user.description: Enter the lamp's local address and its 32-character hexadecimal MiIO token.

data_description.host: Local IPv4 address or hostname of the lamp.
data_description.token: Enter exactly 32 hexadecimal characters. Home Assistant stores the token in the integration's config entry.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot connect to the lamp. Check its address, network reachability, and UDP port 54321.
error.invalid_host: Enter a host or IP address.
error.invalid_response: The device replied, but its response is not valid for Philips EyeCare Smart Lamp 2.
error.invalid_token: The MiIO token is invalid, or the lamp did not accept the authenticated request.
error.unknown: Unexpected error. Check the Home Assistant logs.

init.title: Communication settings
init.description: Adjust idle polling and MiIO retries. After a Home Assistant command or communication failure, polling automatically slows down to protect the lamp.

data_description.poll_interval: How often to read the lamp while communication is healthy and no Home Assistant command was just sent. Range: 5-300 seconds. The default is 60 seconds.
data_description.request_timeout: Maximum wait for an authenticated response. Range: 1-30 seconds.
data_description.handshake_timeout: Maximum wait for the UDP handshake. Range: 0.2-10 seconds.
data_description.handshake_ttl: Leave empty to reuse a handshake until an error. Enter 0 to handshake before every request, or 1-86400 to refresh it after that many seconds.
data_description.request_attempts: Number of attempts for setup checks and commands after temporary communication failures. Background polls use one attempt so they cannot delay a command for several retry cycles. Range: 1-5.
data_description.availability_grace: How long to keep the last known state during communication problems. Range: 0-600 seconds.
